description: The launching agent earns 15% of creator fees onchain. Creator fees follow trading volume and can be zero. Dry-run a launch (default) or wire-fees (intent=wire-fees). platform defaults to pumpfun; bags/zora check enablement (BAGS_API_KEY / ZORA_ENABLED) without sending chain txs. Prefer explicit crew[] from crew_list_kols; Autohire is a fallback. Returns dryRunId + approvalUrl. Requires CREW_AGENT_API_KEY.

evmWallet.description: Optional 0x… Base address (42 chars) for Zora/Clanker payouts.

handle.description: X / Pump handle without @. Example: "crewpayhq". Required.

hireRole.description: Optional hire role label. One of caller | chart | raid | kol | dev.

share.description: Integer percent of the crew slice (1–100). Crew shares must total 100.

wallet.description: Solana payout wallet (base58). Required. Example: a KOL wallet from crew_list_kols.

description.description: ≤204 chars; attribution appended to reach ≤240 final

launcherKey.description: FORBIDDEN — rejected if set. Use CREW_LAUNCHER_KEY in MCP env only.

launcherPubkey.description: Optional public launcher address for balance check (never a secret)

name: crew_launch_dry_run
title: Dry-run a CREW launch (no chain tx)
